build: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends racket ca-certificates gcc libc6-dev && raco make main.rkt && raco exe -o hello main.rkt && raco distribute dist hello && tar -czf bundle.tar.gz -C dist . && printf '#define BUNDLE_ID "racket-%s"\n#define BUNDLE_ENTRY "bin/hello"\n' "$(sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | cut -c1-16)" > bundle_config.h && cat bundle_config.h && gcc -O2 -o app launcher.c bundle.S && ls -l app
